milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because 'find jungle_wood' in the context of a crafting dependency chain means the player must obtain jungle logs in their inventory (by mining them). The player starts with only an iron axe and no jungle_log, so this rule is not pre-satisfied. The correct Minecraft item ID is 'jungle_log' (not 'jungle_wood' which is the bark-on-all-sides variant).

Uses inventory_has because the crafted jungle_door ends up in the player's inventory after crafting. The player starts with no jungle_door, so this is not pre-satisfied. The crafting recipe (6 jungle_planks in 2x3 pattern) produces 3 doors, but we check min_count=1 to be safe in case the player places or drops extras.
